source_inspiration.usage_note: Used only as outside demand evidence for recipe/cookbook/social promotion automation. No AIPRM prompt text was copied and no engagement was imported as PathForge activity.

pathforge_fit_adaptation: The outside user need is recipe/cookbook/social promotion automation. For PathForge, this was altered into a self-contained offline caption-pack sorter where a creator enters one leftover/recipe idea, selects deterministic caption angles, groups callouts and hashtags, sees readiness warnings, and exports a compact promo pack. It avoids hosted model generation, external APIs, CDN assets, remote fonts, logins, and multi-file bundles so the artifact can mount safely on PathForge at mobile width.
final_artifact_clue: Default artifact is the final repaired mobile HTML tool with stable warning list, safe DOM rendering, caption angle sorting, hashtag/callout grouping, copy, and TXT download.

artifact_versions.notes: First real artifact. Rejected for inline handlers and dynamic innerHTML warning clearing.

verification_notes: Static final scan passed: no remote URLs, no CDN/script/font dependencies, no inline event attributes, no innerHTML/outerHTML/insertAdjacentHTML, one inline script only.

steps.prompt_exact: The safer version mostly works, but I found a bug: after the warnings clear, the warning box gets emptied, so later warnings do not come back when I remove the recipe name. steps.response_summary: Gemini kept the safe-DOM approach and fixed the warning list so it remains stable and repopulates correctly.
